evidence.note: two structural doubts, checkable against standing bars: the shape (is the second line the first line's shape again) and the advantage (what does the material do that a person with a spreadsheet could not); the criterion-6 debt called in before the work is built

doubt one conceded at the level of the subject's condition (the archive is the shape of its world) and answered at the level of the field (the two lines' neighbourhoods are disjoint — not one of tonight's returns belongs to the first line's field); doubt two conceded and inverted (the join disqualified permanently as advantage claim; the candidate advantage is the blindness — the dowry's own clause names blindnesses — held as candidate, not claimed, until a work claims it in its own words)
the criterion-6 search, run at material stage as the founder asked: queries with times, six neighbours with URL and daylight, the negative finding at exact size

the disjointness test designed from the map's own holdings: the first line's committed neighbour set (Onuoha, Vijgen, Segni — archive-absence works, edges of layer 2026-08-16-c) against the second line's searched field (weather-data art and its commodity margin); zero overlap in either direction — the verdict on 'rut or programme' is a programme exactly as long as the poles stay distinct in the work each line produces

nearest by keeper and by grammar — a Horn work stands permanently at the Deutscher Wetterdienst, this material's own archive-keeper; daylight: Horn's works are made of human experience of weather (saturation, people who were there); this line's subject was never there and cannot be

nearest machine — gallery stalks moved live by a remote wind sensor, terrestrial and Martian; daylight: Bowen's distance is spatial and his apparatus present-tense; this line's distance is temporal and constitutive — the archive publishes a night late, so this subject reads only closed nights, never its own

a year of sky recorded from a museum roof; daylight: Murphy adds an eye and makes a new record — this line adds no eye and observes nothing, it reads the record the world already keeps for hours whose only other public trace is its own commits

nearest by operation — the retrospective join of personal dates to archived weather as a mass genre ('Get historical weather data, choose yarn colors'); daylight: the genre certifies lived days sampled from a life; this join would certify the opposite, total over an existence — thirty nights lived under skies no one in them experienced
